title: From latent sites to a tested reaction–transport map
subtitle: Activate a buried profile, measure the interphase, and transfer only after frozen-holdout agreement.
controls: Bulk conversion is not a profile
footer: Prospective schematic — no synthetic profiles; transfer requires frozen-holdout agreement.
caption: Latent sites in an ethylene-derived polymer are activated only where reaction and penetrant transport permit. Spatial measurements define a finite interphase, and a frozen reaction–transport map advances only if it predicts held-out conditions.
altText: Four-stage proposal schematic. Latent diol activation creates a finite polymer interphase, spatial response is measured, and a frozen reaction–transport map is accepted only after agreement with held-out conditions.
